sense: a form or edition of something

terms.gloss: an edition; a version (of a book or text; by extension of a program)
evidence: Quint. 5.11.40: nōn in omnī ēditiōne reperītur
terms.comment: Classically the publishing of a book, and an edition of it (Quint., Plin. Ep.); its use for a version of a program is modern.

terms.gloss: a form; a version (of a text, a draft)

phrases.latin: Megariōs ab Athēniēnsibus, cum dē Salamīne contenderent, victōs Homērī versū, quī tamen ipse nōn in omnī ēditiōne reperītur
phrases.english: that the Megarians, in their dispute with the Athenians over Salamis, were beaten by a line of Homer, a line not found, however, in every edition

sources: Lewis & Short: editio · Lewis & Short: forma
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. edition; draft: version.
